title: F7 raw GBrain projection write/readback tuple
$comment: Historical F7 v2 artifact retained only for audit and migration review. The F7 v3 gate consumes f7-raw-evidence-artifact.v1.schema.json and requires gbrain.projection/v2.
description: A versioned raw JSON artifact bound by artifact_id and SHA-256 from an F7 projection check. It contains the complete DPS scope, logical-to-external source mapping, logical projection revision, exact write/readback checksum tuple, and both exact canonical gbrain.projection/v1 byte sequences so the runner can independently recompute the checksums.

external_source_alias.description: Short non-PII alias derived as gs_ plus the first 16 hex characters of SHA-256('dps-gbrain-external-source/v1\n' + logical_source_id).

external_revision.description: Optional external GBrain metadata; never DPS logical truth.

written_projection_base64.description: Exact canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes for a schema-valid gbrain.projection/v1 DTO, Base64 encoded. The runner recomputes written_checksum and validates the contract/scope tuple. This external artifact is sensitive and must not enter Git or logs.

readback_projection_base64.description: Exact externally read-back projection bytes, Base64 encoded. The runner recomputes read_checksum and requires byte equality with written_projection_base64.
